report: Quiet day for the account. The trader placed no orders and nothing filled. Today's input has no market news and no trader reasoning, so I cannot say what moved our themes or why it stayed out. The PCE result, the tariff announcement and the Sanofi reaction are still missing. The account is flat at 1969.83 euros. That is zero for the day and minus 1.51 percent since the start. There are no open positions and no pending orders, so there are no exit dates or stops to watch. The broker reconcile is consistent. One warning: a handoff note was rejected for being over 6000 bytes. Tomorrow's note has to stay short. Six more shadow calls were scored. Up calls are now 1 right out of 10, with an average move of minus 4.9 percent. Down calls are 7 out of 7, with an average of minus 9.9 percent. New this time: the Infineon down call was right at minus 16 percent and BESI up was wrong at minus 8. The Equinor down call after the cyberattack was right. GSK up on its US approval was right, at plus 2.7 percent. Be careful with this split. It mostly shows that the market fell, not that the calls were skilful. Only one real trade has closed, the Infineon loss, so it is far too early to judge the trader.
questions: Down shadow calls are 7 of 7 right and up calls 1 of 10. That looks like a falling market more than skill. Should we compare each call to the STOXX50 or its sector, not to zero?
